results.label: this tree ships the clean-rep count (src/challenge.js) (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the card is its own section, so a dashboard can mount it without a layout change
and the card is mounted on the dashboard and loaded by the page exactly when the tree ships it
an unreadable count says UNKNOWN and says in as many words that this is not zero reps and not a clean count
and it renders no figure at all: not 0, not 0/21, and no bar pretending to be progress
an unavailable card still refuses to be a money or a grade surface: the words appear only to deny them, and no figure is rendered
an unstarted card says `not started` and that nothing is counted yet, in the words that make it unmistakable
and it offers the trader the two declarations rather than an empty box: a start button and a target field already carrying the DEFAULT 21
the unstarted card names the three criteria so the exercise is not a mystery, and states that it counts trades and never days
a live count renders the count and the target as the trader’s own numbers, and the remaining figure as arithmetic on them
the bar is the ratio of counted reps to the target, so it can never claim progress the count does not have
the window tally attributes every closed trade: how many closed, how many did not count, and why, criterion by criterion
the trades excluded by the start day are labelled as excluded rather than as failures, beside the closes that cannot be dated and the read bound
a trade with no recorded checklist is called out in the trader’s own interest: no record is not a clean record
the journalling proxy is stated as a proxy: the same UTC close day, the acknowledgement, and the observed gap beside it
the newest trades are listed with counted/not-counted and the reason, so a failure is attributable to a trade rather than to the trader
the count is never turned into money, a grade or a score anywhere on the card: the only mention of each is the sentence refusing it
and the run is explained as a run of reps that a failed trade restarts WITHOUT erasing the count — the punishment reading is closed on the card itself
the card states plainly that days are not the measure, beside the one day figure it reports as information only
the target is editable and the count is not: saving the target posts ONLY the target, so no click can move a record
and the write it performs is the settings route with the rep target the trader typed — no new endpoint, no count edit
starting the count posts the trader’s OWN day through the same route, and refreshes the dashboard rather than pretending locally
the card claims no authority at all: not one permission, cap or decision is spoken of as something the count can grant or refuse
a card rendered for ANOTHER workspace or account refuses to write and says so, instead of saving a declaration into the wrong journal
an unusable stored target is reported as such and NO remaining figure is invented from the default: the card does not quietly substitute 21
and a count past the target is reported as beyond it rather than as a failure to stop: the exercise has no ceiling to enforce
a STARTED count with no trades yet shows a real zero — which is a different thing from an unstarted count, and the card keeps them apart

scope: M115 real DOM: the clean-rep card the dashboard reads: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
